title: Coordinated incentives in AI-generated misinformation governance
abstract: arXiv:2608.07070v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: With the rapid diffusion of AI-generated content, AI-driven misinformation is becoming increasingly pervasive and difficult to govern, undermining information credibility and social trust. This study models the strategic interdependence among a government regulator, an AI enterprise, and users through a three-party evolutionary game that incorporates heterogeneous rewards and punishments. From the resulting replicator equations, we characterize the evolutionary stability of competing governance and production strategies. The analysis indicates that neither unilateral regulation nor market incentives alone can effectively curb misinformation. Instead, an evolutionarily stable regime of real-information production arises only when regulatory rewards and punishment intensity, enterprise reputation loss, and user adoption incentives collectively surpass critical thresholds. translated_title: AI生成错误信息治理中的协调激励机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.07070v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：随着AI生成内容的快速扩散，AI驱动的错误信息日益普遍且难以治理，削弱了信息可信度和社会信任。本研究通过一个包含异质奖惩的三方演化博弈模型，模拟了政府监管机构、AI企业和用户之间的战略相互依赖。基于由此得到的复制者方程，我们刻画了竞争性治理与生产策略的演化稳定性。分析表明，单方面的监管或市场激励均无法有效遏制错误信息。相反，只有当监管奖惩力度、企业声誉损失和用户采纳激励共同超过临界阈值时，才会出现真实信息生产的演化稳定状态。研究结果强调了协调且适应性治理机制的必要性。
tldr: 本研究发现，仅靠单一监管或市场激励无法遏制AI错误信息，只有政府奖惩、企业声誉损失和用户激励协同超过临界阈值时，才能实现真实信息生产的演化稳定。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that neither unilateral regulation nor market incentives alone can curb AI-driven misinformation; only when regulatory rewards and punishments, enterprise reputation loss, and user incentives collectively exceed critical thresholds does an evolutionarily stable regime of real-information production emerge.
